page.layout: One printed page, single column of verse with headings; running head at top; page number at top left; catchword-like word "ICONES" at lower right of text block (treated as catchword).

main_text.p: Iure sub hanc propriam crux, laqueúsque tulit. Exitus vt iustus, sic iusta iniusta fuerunt, Corpore sacrilego quod caruere canes.
main_text.head: IOANNI IVELLO.
main_text.p: REgina gemina pari labore, Verùm non animo pari, Iuelle, Fecerunt, pietas vt esset orbi Illustris tua. Sauiendo ferro Et igne altera id egit, vt niteret Virtus temporibus probata duris: Vt aurum solet ignibus recoctum. Iusto te altera prosequens honore Produxit patria in theatrum: & oris Tot dotes, animíque adhuc latentes Ostendit populo: sed eruditis Et plenis pietatis, entheóque Feruore ingenij libris, nepotum Famam in saecula dum tuam propagat, Illiúsque odio, istiúsque amore Maiorem ipsi tibi celebritatem Fama in tempora cunctla comparasti.
main_text.head: EIDEM.
main_text.p: IVelle, mater quem tulit Denonia, Nutrixque fouit erudita Oxonia, Quem Maria ferro & igne patria expulit, Virtus reduxit, Praesulem fecit parens Elisabetha docta doctarum artium: Puluis pusillus te sepulchri hic contegit. Quàm parua tellus nomen ingens occulit?

page.notes: Woodcut-style initials R and I are rendered as plain capitals. Page edges show show-through and stains, omitted. The heading "ICONES" is set at the lower right and was read as a catchword; the verse lines with long s were transcribed as plain s.
